Beside him, a brown dog sits patiently on the dusty ground, its tail curled tightly around its paws. In the center, a woman in a blue apron reaches out to accept the wheat from the farmer's hands. To her right, a small child in yellow overalls points excitedly toward a wooden cart overflowing with pumpkins. Perched atop the highest pumpkin is a black crow, watching the scene with keen interest. The farmer looks at the woman as he passes the bundle. The child looks at the crow while pointing. There is no tractor visible in the field.
